baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive clause 'in hadha illa' predicates both sihr and the passive yu'thar of the deictic 'this'.
baseline_models.mechanism: An uttered verdict reduces the encountered discourse to perceptual diversion and assigns that diversion a human transmission channel.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the public act that launches the restrictive classification.
Diversion and deception supply the alleged mechanism that turns perception from a thing's true face.
A report handed down through transmission supplies the alleged origin and continuity of the deception.

changed_reading.before: The speaker simply calls the discourse magic.
changed_reading.after: The speaker offers a total causal reduction: deceptive effect plus inherited human transmission exhaust what 'this' is.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Fa-qala is itself a new saying, while yu'thar labels the object as something carried onward in report.
baseline_models.mechanism: The accusation is recursive: it alleges that the discourse gains force by circulation while simultaneously adding another hostile report to that circulation.

activation_trace.role: Circulating public talk makes the speaker's verdict one more report capable of spreading among people.
Deceptive diversion supplies the pejorative content that the new report circulates.
Transmission until a report becomes inherited supplies the recursive pathway alleged and enacted by the statement.

changed_reading.before: The sentence reports a property of an external discourse.
changed_reading.after: The sentence also performs the transmission it condemns, converting the accusation into a self-propagating rumor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Yu'thar can activate the root image of a remaining sign that points back to what occurred.
baseline_models.mechanism: Instead of locating the magic in a lineage of narrators, the phrase can locate it in an aftereffect: an alleged deception inferred from the trace it leaves.

activation_trace.role: Deceptive diversion supplies the proposed event whose effects would need to be detected.
A surviving mark that indicates what was supplies an evidentiary rather than genealogical reading of yu'thar.

changed_reading.before: The magic is inherited from earlier tellers.
changed_reading.after: The magic is alleged to be traceable by a residue or aftereffect, with transmission left as a competing parse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive yu'thar also remains attached to the athar branch of preferring or giving priority.
baseline_models.mechanism: The restrictive claim can attack reception rather than antiquity: this is merely magic that is being preferred or favored by its hearers.

activation_trace.role: Magic as deceptive diversion supplies the object of the alleged preference.
Preferring and giving priority supply a grammatically possible passive alternative to handed-down transmission.

changed_reading.before: The accusation explains the discourse by its inherited past.
changed_reading.after: The accusation may instead complain about a present act of audience preference, though the transmission reading remains stronger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus saying is the terminal output of repeated inward fluctuation, calculated arrangement, and directed looking; it reads as a manufactured verdict rather than an immediate perception.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the externalized endpoint of the preceding process.
The heart's repeated movement over a matter supplies an unsettled internal search before the verdict.
Managing an affair through estimation and review supplies deliberate construction of the eventual label.
Directing sight or insight toward an object supplies the inspection stage that precedes speech.

structural_cues: The repeated thumma sequence in 74:18-23 delays fa-qala until after thought, estimation, looking, facial contraction, and recoil.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a staged cognitive and bodily sequence ending in speech; I infer that the sequence manufactures the label as a usable verdict; a live alternative is that it merely narrates sincere but failed deliberation.

changed_reading.before: He spontaneously identifies what he hears as transmitted magic.
changed_reading.after: He laboriously engineers 'transmitted magic' as the reductive formulation that can cap and stabilize his resistance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats the same restrictive frame and converts the focus into the first half of a paired taxonomy: deceptive mechanism in 74:24, then merely human provenance in 74:25.

activation_trace.role: Diversion and deception supply the first reduction, which dismisses how the discourse affects perception.
Handed-down report supplies the first clause's account of continuity.
A saying used as definition or essence supplies the parallel clause's categorical recoding of the discourse.
The visibly embodied human supplies the ordinary mortal source to which the second reduction confines the discourse.

structural_cues: 74:24 and 74:25 repeat 'in hadha illa' with matching nominal predicates, making the two accusations cumulative rather than independent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two adjacent restrictive definitions; I infer an ordered attack on effect and source; a live alternative is simple synonymous repetition for emphasis without a two-stage taxonomy.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a complete accusation by itself.
changed_reading.after: The focus opens a double reduction that first naturalizes the discourse's force as magic and then naturalizes its source as mortal speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later states a general testing mechanism in which one sign yields increased certainty in some receivers and disturbed doubt followed by skeptical speech in others; the focus utterance becomes an earlier specimen of that diagnostic output.

activation_trace.role: Saying as a held doctrine makes the focus utterance disclose the speaker's settled stance, not only convey information.
The explicitly produced skeptical saying supplies a same-surah template for speech generated by a test.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the diagnostic process that differentiates receivers.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies one possible result of the assay.
Agitated doubt supplies the contrary receiver-state from which dismissive speech can emerge.

structural_cues: In 74:31 the stated fitna is followed by divergent epistemic effects and then by the question 'what did God intend by this example?'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit test-to-receiver-state-to-speech sequence; I infer that 74:24 instantiates the same causal pattern retrospectively; a live alternative is that 74:31 governs only the number of guardians and should not generalize to the earlier discourse.

changed_reading.before: The utterance is primarily a claim about the nature of 'this'.
changed_reading.after: The utterance is also evidence about the claimant: the tested object precipitates a verbal signature of resistant reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sihr branch of deceptive diversion coexists with the root's sahar or predawn edge; the later retreat of night and unveiling of dawn turns the accusation's root into a threshold where alleged illusion is countered by disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Magic as diversion from a thing's true face supplies the speaker's charge of visual or persuasive distortion.
The predawn time supplies a latent threshold image within the same focus root.
Turning the back supplies the night's retreat and echoes the human recoil immediately before the focus speech.
Night and its darkness supply the obscured side of the perceptual threshold.
The first light of day supplies the temporal realization of the focus root's predawn edge.
Removing a cover supplies disclosure as the direction of the dawn sequence.

structural_cues: The oath sequence 74:32-35 moves from moon, through a retreating night, to a dawn that unveils before declaring the matter one of the great things.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both sihr and sahar images under one root plus a literal night-to-dawn unveiling; I infer a deliberate reversal from alleged deception to disclosure; a live alternative is that the vowel-distinct predawn branch is only lexical resonance and does not revise sihr here.

changed_reading.before: Sihr names an effect that hides reality from sight.
changed_reading.after: The accusation unwittingly occupies the predawn threshold of a surah that soon stages reality being uncovered as night turns away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later confession joins entering discourse with other entrants to the act of denial; this supplies the social mechanism by which the focus accusation can become exactly the inherited, circulating speech it alleges.

activation_trace.role: Publicly circulating talk supplies the medium in which the accusation can be copied and normalized.
A report transmitted until handed down supplies the process that the accusation both names and enacts.
Entering into talk or an affair supplies collective participation in an already moving discourse.
Attributing falsehood supplies the shared discourse's determinate act of denial.

structural_cues: The plural confession in 74:45-46 places participation 'with those who participate' immediately before denial of judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collective entry into discourse followed by denial; I infer social reproduction as the arrow connecting that confession to the earlier public accusation; a live alternative is that khawd denotes broad misconduct rather than verbal imitation specifically.

changed_reading.before: The speaker accuses the message of being inherited speech.
changed_reading.after: His accusation appears as inherited denial: a socially reproduced formula that projects its own transmission mechanism onto the message.

context_deltas.mechanism: The utterance follows an immediate bodily turn and is later enveloped by a sequence of turning aside, recoiling, and fleeing from the reminder; saying 'magic' functions as verbal locomotion away from an address.

activation_trace.role: The uttered verdict supplies the verbal action that continues the speaker's physical withdrawal.
Turning one's back and averting supplies the immediate directional movement into the focus saying.
Presenting one's side and turning away supplies the later general diagnosis of the same avoidance.
Recoiling and distancing from something supplies the affective acceleration of the turn-away.
Flight supplies the completed movement away, making avoidance the causal function of the label.

structural_cues: 74:23-24 joins turning away to saying with fa, while 74:49-51 expands turning from the reminder into a flight simile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate recoil before qawl and a later explanation of rejection as flight; I infer that the label enables continued withdrawal; a live alternative is that bodily actions characterize emotion without assigning an evasive function to the proposition itself.

changed_reading.before: The line is an intellectual explanation, however mistaken.
changed_reading.after: The line is an escape maneuver: speech gives conceptual form to the body's turn away and permits the speaker to keep retreating.

context_deltas.mechanism: The demand that each person receive opened or published sheets shows that mediated writing is not rejected in itself; against that demand, 'magic handed down' becomes a struggle over who controls address, authorization, and transmission.

activation_trace.role: Handed-down report, including narrated or written learning, supplies the medium disparaged in the focus.
A written sheet supplies the individualized medium that each rejecter instead demands.
Published writing supplies the desired form of open, personally authorized transmission.

structural_cues: After depicting flight from the reminder, 74:52 contrasts that refusal with each person's wish to be given published sheets.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejection of a handed-down message alongside desire for individualized written sheets; I infer a contest over privileged control of address rather than mediation itself; a live alternative is that the requested sheets express an evidentiary demand with no status motive.

changed_reading.before: Yu'thar is a complaint that the message is mediated through prior humans.
changed_reading.after: Yu'thar is also a delegitimizing label for an unwanted transmission channel, voiced by people who still desire transmission when it arrives as a document addressed to each of them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing pairing of willing with remembering reactivates the focus athar branch of preference: yu'thar can momentarily describe a message selected by hearers, not only one transmitted from predecessors.

activation_trace.role: Preference and priority supply the alternate passive sense 'is preferred' at the focus.
Will directed toward a thing supplies the closing surah's explicit selection mechanism.
Bringing something to mind with retention supplies the act selected by the willing receiver.

structural_cues: 74:54-56 renames the discourse a reminder and twice binds remembering to will, first human and then divine.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus preference branch and a closing will-to-remember construction; I infer that the close reopens the passive 'is preferred' parse; the materially stronger alternative remains ordinary report-transmission in yu'thar.

changed_reading.before: The speaker says the magic has been handed down from the past.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the speaker says this is magic being preferred, making contested selection and reception rather than antiquity the target of his complaint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the color-changing toy branch of sihr with the packet's non-dominant th-w-r mapping for the focus root; it remains anchored because both branches are explicitly supplied for focus words; downstream prose should present it only as split-root image resonance, not as a claim that the conventional morphology has been disambiguated this way.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Sihr and yu'thar are adjacent focus predicates, allowing a manipulated visual display to pair with an image of stirring something from rest.

activation_trace.role: A toy that changes color when pulled in opposite directions supplies a concrete model of controlled perceptual switching.
Stirring something out of a settled state supplies the manipulation that activates the changing display.

changed_reading.before: The speaker alleges old magic passed from teller to teller.
changed_reading.after: The phrase briefly images a display deliberately stirred into a shifting visible state, a material analogy for the manipulation being alleged.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the human-source accusation to the skin sense of bashar and then to heat changing color; it remains valid as a same-root material sequence anchored to the focus act of categorical saying; downstream prose should mark it as a lexical rebound across 74:25 and 74:29, not collapse human beings into literal skin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus qawl initiates a categorical definition that continues in the next ayah with 'speech of al-bashar'.

activation_trace.role: Saying as definition supplies the categorical act whose human label is made to rebound materially.
The visible skin or surface supplies a material underside to the label 'human'.
Heat leaving an effect and changing color supplies the later action upon that exposed human surface.

changed_reading.before: The follow-on phrase merely assigns the discourse a human author.
changed_reading.after: The humanizing label rebounds onto the visible human surface that the subsequent warning says will bear a changed-color trace.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the surah's opening and closing coverings against the trace branch of yu'thar; it remains anchored in the focus word's surviving-mark image and exact context branches; downstream prose should qualify it as a whole-surah image frame, not as an alternate direct translation of the focus clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yu'thar can evoke a remaining mark whose visibility or harmful consequence can be covered.

activation_trace.role: A surviving sign supplies the trace positioned between the surah's two covering images.
A trace effaced as successive coverings pass over it supplies the opening possibility of obscured evidence.
Covering a wrong and protecting its bearer from its effect supplies the closing transformation of what a trace can do.

changed_reading.before: Yu'thar only locates the alleged magic in a chain of old reports.
changed_reading.after: Yu'thar becomes a central trace between an opening image of marks being covered over and a closing image of harmful effects being protectively covered.

strongest_changes: The pre-focus thought and estimation sequence changes qawl from spontaneous perception into an engineered verdict.
The explicit test-to-certainty-or-doubt-to-speech mechanism in 74:31 changes the accusation into diagnostic evidence about its speaker.
The collective discourse and denial of 74:45-46 strengthen the reflexive reading in which the accusation reproduces the transmission it alleges.
The later turn-away and flight sequence makes the sentence function as an evasive act, not merely a mistaken proposition.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converted a compact classificatory sentence into an event: calculated speech, a receiver-test output, socially copied denial, and verbal flight. It also kept minority focus branches alive through the dawn, personalized-sheet, and will-to-remember sequences without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The predawn activation may be meaningful root resonance while remaining too vowel-distant to revise sihr lexically.
The passive preference reading of yu'thar is grammatically live but much less secure than handed-down transmission.
The th-w-r split mapping, human-surface rebound, and covering frame should remain exploratory image mechanisms rather than asserted translations.
